claims.claim: Unassisted agent output on the SUS 4-surface corpus scored 25-31/55 acceptance with 2 of 4 surfaces failing the G4 contrast gate (2026-11-14 measurement).
The first three blocking scanner rules measure precision 1.0 and recall 1.0 on the labelled corpus (5 positive files, 1 negative file with 8 registered counterexamples).
Chars/4 is a conservative token estimate for English UI copy and is used consistently by the skill validator, JIT loader and budget CLI until real usage metadata exists.

questions: Do baseline scores hold when fixtures gain interactive states?

plans.stopRule: stop when both questions have measured answers or the 4-source budget is spent
